step_limit_definition: runner model-action turns, including the final done turn and invalid/failed turns; the same limit is passed to run_llm_task
actual_environment_steps_definition: successful non-done environment transitions: trajectory step events with a parsed action, ok=true, and action.type != done; wait counts, the final done action does not
termination_policy: stop normally when the agent emits done
stop the agent loop at 30 model-action turns
stop cooperatively between blocking calls when the 720-second execution allocation is exhausted
treat an unrecoverable initialization/runtime error as stage_error after cleanup is attempted
for an information stage, a semantic-judge timeout yields UNCERTAIN and mandatory human audit
the outer stage launcher enforces the 900-second total budget and records the terminal cause

aggregation.local_all: all isolated stages for the original task pass after UNCERTAIN adjudication
aggregation.e2e: version-matched E2E success on the same Final-60 task
aggregation.composition_gap: Local-All success rate minus E2E success rate
aggregation.budget_feasible_robustness: optional: recompute Local-All on tasks whose isolated-stage actual-step sum is within the declared comparison threshold; report the threshold explicitly
